# vaultwarden_folder (Data Source)

Use this data source to look up a folder in the personal vault of the provider user by ID or name.

Requires `email` and `master_password` to be set in the provider configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "vaultwarden_folder" "by_name" {
  name = "Infrastructure"
}

data "vaultwarden_folder" "by_id" {
  id = "a1b2c3d4-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The ID of the folder to look up. Exactly one of `id` and `name` must be set
- `name` (String) The name of the folder to look up, compared exactly. Folder names are not unique: when several folders have the name, the lookup fails and lists their IDs. Exactly one of `id` and `name` must be set
